items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: Is his right name Dr. Blanks? No, his name was Herbert Blanks. Herbert Blanks? And he married my sister.

ctx.x: I was going to ask you about him. Who is Dr. Blanks?

That's the band you used to sing with. White Tails. He used to sing in White Tails. Is his right name Dr. Blanks? No, his name was Herbert Blanks. Herbert Blanks? And he married my sister. He's got a $30,000 home now in the basin. What a little country town's out there. Bay St. Louis. What a little town.
